sourceCourseTitle: Créer des agents d’IA avec CrewAI

description.en: Commencez par les bases de CrewAI en créant votre tout premier agent d’IA. Assignez‑lui des tâches, combinez‑le avec des outils et lancez votre première équipe de recherche — pour voir comment des agents isolés deviennent un véritable pipeline opérationnel.

body.fr:
## Avant de commencer

Ce cours se réalise directement dans Neopolis avec des activités interactives. Pour les mises en situation, préparez un chatbot IA autorisé par votre organisation ; ne partagez jamais de données sensibles, de mots de passe ou de clés API.
body.en:
## Before you start

This course is completed in Neopolis through interactive activities. For the scenarios, prepare an AI chatbot approved by your organization; never share sensitive data, passwords, or API keys.

1. Bienvenue sur CrewAI !
Welcome to "Building Multi-AI Agent Systems with CrewAI"—where we turn AI from a single chatbot into a team that ships real work.

2. Créer un studio de contenu IA
I’m really excited you’re here, because by the end of our journey, we’ll have a working pipeline where AI agents research,

3. Votre formateur pour ce parcours
analyze,

and generate content with minimal human effort—our own digital content studio of specialists collaborating like researchers, writers, and an orchestrator.

5. Votre formateur pour ce parcours
I’m Tony Kipkemboi, Senior Developer Relations Engineer at CrewAI, and I’m here to guide you from first principles to running multi-agent workflows.

6. Construire bloc par bloc
We’ll start small with one agent,

7. Construire bloc par bloc
then layer in tasks

8. Construire bloc par bloc
and assemble crews.

9. Construire bloc par bloc
From there, we’ll orchestrate stateful flows with decision-making and memory, so our system can choose the right path, remember what happened, and resume if something fails.

10. Apprendre en pratiquant
To make this hands-on, you’ll have access to DataLab notebooks as part of the videos. This means you can follow along with the examples, experiment with the code yourself, and see results immediately. No previous AI agent experience is required — CrewAI makes it simple to get started.

11. Prêt à rejoindre l’équipe ?
If you’re comfortable writing

12. Prêt à rejoindre l’équipe ?
Python functions, working with dictionaries and loops,

13. Prêt à rejoindre l’équipe ?
and using APIs, you’ll be well prepared to get the most out of the hands-on exercises.

14. Prêt à rejoindre l’équipe ?
By the finish line, we’ll know how to design and deploy our own multi-agent pipelines—flexible, automated systems that adapt to real-world use cases, like the researcher-and-writer workflow we’ll build, that can write blogs, LinkedIn posts, and newsletters!

15. Passons à la pratique !
Ready to go from a chatbot to a crew? Let’s get started!

projectorSlides.title: Félicitations !
projectorSlides.script: Congratulations on completing this course on building multi-AI agent systems with CrewAI!

projectorSlides.script: You’ve accomplished a lot in this course. We started by defining a single agent with a

projectorSlides.title: De l’agent à l’équipe

projectorSlides.title: De l’agent à l’équipe
projectorSlides.script:
Finally, we brought it all together, orchestrating multiple crews under one flow to build a flexible, automated content pipeline.

At this point, you’ve gone from building a simple research agent to designing a full multi-agent system to automate research, content creation, and decision-making with minimal human input.

projectorSlides.script:
Thank you for learning with me. I hope you’re inspired to take these ideas further and build your own multi-agent systems.

And if you'd like to continue learning, I encourage you to keep exploring CrewAI’s latest features to get inspiration, and continue experimenting on your own on DataLab!
